name: CO2 emissions (metric tons per capita)
description: Carbon dioxide emissions from energy use, per person.

name: CO2 emissions (kt)
description: Total carbon dioxide emissions in kilotons.

name: Total greenhouse gas emissions (kt CO2 eq)
description: Sum of all greenhouse gas emissions.

name: Methane emissions (kt CO2 eq)
description: Methane emissions in carbon dioxide equivalent.

name: Nitrous oxide emissions (kt CO2 eq)
description: Nitrous oxide emissions in carbon dioxide equivalent.

name: Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy)
description: Share of renewable energy in total final energy consumption.

name: Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity)
description: Share of electricity produced from renewable sources.

name: Forest area (% of land area)
description: Forest area is land under natural or planted stands of trees.

name: PM2.5 air pollution, mean annual exposure (micrograms/m³)
description: Population-weighted exposure to ambient PM2.5.

name: Access to electricity (% of population)
description: Percentage of population with access to electricity.

name: Total natural resources rents (% of GDP)
description: Sum of oil rents, natural gas rents, coal rents, mineral rents, and forest rents.

name: Agricultural land (% of land area)
description: Share of land area that is arable, under permanent crops, or permanent pastures.

name: Terrestrial & marine protected areas (% of total area)
description: Percentage of territorial area that is nationally protected.

name: Energy use (kg oil equivalent per capita)
description: Energy use per person, measured in kg of oil equivalent.

name: Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)
description: Share of electricity generated using coal.

name: Life expectancy at birth, total (years)
description: Number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of its birth were to stay the same.

name: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)
description: Probability of dying between birth and exactly five years of age per 1,000 live births.

name: People using safely managed drinking water (% of population)
description: Percentage of people using drinking water from an improved source that is accessible on premises, available when needed and free from contamination.

name: People using safely managed sanitation (% of population)
description: Percentage of people using improved sanitation facilities that are not shared with other households and where excreta are safely disposed of in situ or transported and treated off-site.

name: School enrollment, primary (% gross)
description: Total enrollment in primary education, regardless of age, expressed as a percentage of the population of official primary education age.

name: School enrollment, secondary (% gross)
description: Total enrollment in secondary education, regardless of age.

name: School enrollment, tertiary (% gross)
description: Total enrollment in tertiary education, regardless of age.

name: Literacy rate, adult total (% of people ages 15+)
description: Percentage of people aged 15 and above who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement about their everyday life.

name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force)
description: Share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.

name: Labor force participation rate, female (% of female pop 15+)
description: Percentage of female population aged 15 and older that is economically active.

name: Gini index (World Bank estimate)
description: Gini index measures the extent to which the distribution of income among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution.

name: Poverty headcount ratio at national poverty lines (% of pop)
description: Percentage of the population living below the national poverty line.

name: Access to clean fuels and cooking technologies (% of pop)
description: Percentage of population with primary reliance on clean fuels and technology for cooking.

name: CPIA gender equality rating (1=low to 6=high)
description: Measures the extent to which the country has installed institutions and programs to promote gender equality.

name: GDP growth (annual %)
description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.

name: GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$)
description: GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population, in constant 2015 dollars.

name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
description: Annual percentage change in the cost to the average consumer of acquiring a basket of goods and services.

name: Industry, value added (% of GDP)
description: Net output of industry (mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity, water, gas) divided by GDP.

name: Services, value added (% of GDP)
description: Net output of services sector divided by GDP.

name: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added (% of GDP)
description: Net output of agriculture sector divided by GDP.

name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
description: Net inflows of investment to acquire a lasting management interest in an enterprise operating in an economy other than that of the investor.

name: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Gross domestic expenditure on R&D as a percentage of GDP.

name: High-technology exports (% of manufactured exports)
description: Products with high R&D intensity, such as in aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, scientific instruments, and electrical machinery.

name: Patent applications, residents
description: Patent applications filed by residents of the country.

name: Military expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Military expenditures as a percentage of GDP.

name: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP)
description: Total public expenditure on education (current and capital) expressed as a percentage of GDP.
